versions.changelog:
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to functionality or documentation content; this is a cleanup release.

init-workspace 1.0.1 introduces team chat binding, card interaction, and multi-context identity support.

- Added scripts for chat binding and card/interactive action resolution.
- Now supports team chat (group) binding/unbinding with two-step confirmation, including chat binding status queries.
- Integration with Feishu interactive cards: card button and form responses handled by resolve_card_action.py and resolve_pending_action.py.
- Distinct identity handling: OpenClaw SenderId for private chats, GroupSubject for team/group chats; group binding is per chat_id, not group name.
- Improved initialization flow: user post-init choices are now tracked in active_tasks.json and all responses like "1/2/3" go through action resolution scripts.
- SKILL.md updated with new triggers, identity/binding rules, and error handling details, replacing the sample skill-card.md file.

Initial release of init-workspace skill.

- Enables first-time setup for personal and team knowledge bases.
- Supports creating or joining teams and creating team project areas.
- Configures Gitea repository permissions for users and teams.
- Maintains a central AIFusionBot/system-config control repository.
- Provides robust error handling and recovery for initialization failures.
